integrity: The classification is proved directly from private neighborhoods. The crucial converse shows that any irredundant set meeting more than one part must be a two-vertex transversal between two non-singleton parts. A literal exhaustive verifier independently reconstructs private neighborhoods for every complete multipartite graph through order 9 and checks the classification, both counting polynomials, maximality, and the lower/upper parameters.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordinary vertex irredundance in connected complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts.
The empty set is vacuously irredundant but is excluded from the displayed irredundance polynomial by the standard positive-size convention used here.
The 1979 foundational paper was inspected through its abstract and bibliographic record rather than full text.

The later direct-product theorem was inspected in full and is strictly broader in host construction but weaker for one factor; it does not classify all one-factor irredundant sets or their polynomials.
Finite exhaustive verification through order 9 is supplementary and is not used as proof of the infinite theorem.
title: All irredundant sets of complete multipartite graphs
